channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: A new report found nearly 4 in 10 cancers are linked to preventable causes. Here are the best ways to lower your risk.
item.description: The World Health Organization found that nearly 40% of cancer cases worldwide are linked to preventable causes.

item.title: A recurring character in the Epstein files: Snow White
item.description: In a newly released email, Jeffrey Epstein asks someone to wear a Snow White costume. He and banker Jes Staley also emailed about Snow White.

item.title: Chipotle is targeting the top of the K-shaped economy
item.description: Chipotle plans to raise prices this year, but executives said on Tuesday that their core consumer, who makes over $100k, probably won't mind.

item.title: 'Today' show host Savannah Guthrie's mother Nancy has gone missing. Here's what we know.
item.description: Nancy Guthrie, mother of beloved "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie, has been missing since February 1. Here's what we know about the case.

item.title: OpenAI just snagged an Anthropic safety researcher for its high-profile head of preparedness role
item.description: OpenAI hired an Anthropic safety researcher as its head of preparedness, which pays up to $555,000 plus equity.

item.title: Melissa Joan Hart says cutting 2 things out of her diet helped her lose 18 pounds
item.description: "I really didn't think I could lose weight anymore, being in midlife and perimenopause and all those things," Melissa Joan Hart said.

item.title: PayPal's former president slams the company, says it's lost its 'mojo' and 'ability to compete'
item.description: David Marcus said on X that PayPal was repeating leadership mistakes that had cost the company its edge.

item.title: Darden Restaurants is shutting down the remaining 28 Bahama Breeze locations. Here's the full list.
item.description: Bahama Breeze will permanently close 14 locations by April 5 and convert the other 14 into another Darden-owned restaurant.

item.title: I was sick of never seeing my 6 kids. So I quit my Amazon job to become a tulip farmer.
item.description: After 14 years in the Air Force and National Guard, Andrew Miller landed a corporate role at Amazon — but with 6 kids, it didn't leave him enough time to be a dad.

item.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia would love to back an OpenAI IPO, and there's 'no drama' with Sam Altman
item.description: Jensen Huang said Nvidia would love to back a future OpenAI IPO and dismissed talk of tension with Sam Altman.
